label: MAN UNITED · SOURCES: ESPN
headline: Man United move for Pochettino
sub: Sources told ESPN United have contacted U.S. Soccer before triggering his $10m release clause. Michael Carrick's meeting with the club is on Thursday.
caption:

Sources told ESPN that United have contacted U.S. Soccer before triggering the USMNT coach's $10 million release clause. Michael Carrick, 18th in the Premier League after 10 games, meets the club on Thursday.

label: NBA · WEDNESDAY
headline: Seven straight. 11–2. Best record in the NBA.
sub: Luka Doncic 32, Sandro Mamukelashvili 23, Austin Reaves 18 on his return. The Bucks have lost eight in a row.
caption:
💜💛 The Lakers have won seven in a row.

Luka Doncic scored 32, Sandro Mamukelashvili added 23 against his old team and Austin Reaves had 18 in his return as LA won 123–112 in Milwaukee. At 11–2 they have the best record in the NBA. The Bucks are 1–11.

Lakers or Spurs: who's the best team in the West? 👇

#Lakers #LukaDoncic #NBA

label: NBA · WEDNESDAY
headline: James Harden is back: season-high 32
sub: He came in averaging 15.3. His 3 broke a 101–101 tie with 4:21 left. Karl-Anthony Towns tied a Willis Reed Knicks record.
caption:
🧔 Vintage James Harden.

He came into the night averaging 15.3 points, then scored a season-high 32 and hit the go-ahead 3 as the Cavaliers beat the Knicks 115–107 at MSG. Karl-Anthony Towns (21 & 11) tied Willis Reed's Knicks record with his 11th straight double-double to start a season.

Is Harden's slow start over? 👇

#Cavs #JamesHarden #Knicks
